hook: *Nagarjuna Sagar* storage, Hyderabad's tap water, goes to the river board
hook_b: *Nagarjuna Sagar* storage, Hyderabad's tap water, goes to the river board
tldr: A BRS delegation meets the Krishna River Management Board on Monday to seek protection of Nagarjuna Sagar reserves needed for Hyderabad's drinking water.

beats.what: The delegation of about 10 MLAs, former ministers and senior leaders will ask KRMB to examine permissions, allocations and inter-State agreements for AP's tunnel works.
beats.why: Nagarjuna Sagar storage is crucial for Hyderabad's drinking water, and the party cites the El Nino crisis.
beats.care: Nagarjuna Sagar feeds Hyderabad's drinking water, so its storage level matters for supply in the coming dry months.

causes.label: AP tunnel works near Nagarjuna Sagar

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: BRS wants KRMB to assess the tunnel's impact on Telangana's water rights and keep adequate storage for the city.

cards.q: How worried are you about Hyderabad's water supply next summer?

qs: How much of Hyderabad's water comes from Nagarjuna Sagar this season?
What can KRMB do once a project is under way?

facts.t: Namasthe Telangana reported AP is digging a *₹1,200 crore* tunnel from Nagarjuna Sagar.
The paper says the tunnel could draw water even at the *510 ft* dead storage level.

steps.e: Report: AP digging Rs 1,200 cr tunnel

viz.verdict: An inter-State dispute that can affect city water storage

viz.l: BRS MLAs in the KRMB delegation

cover.label: BRS MLAs in the KRMB delegation

learn.t: KRMB = Krishna River Management Board, which oversees Krishna water sharing between Telangana and AP

watch: KRMB's response to the representation; the board has not been reported acting on it yet.

sources.name: Telangana Today

fact: About *10* BRS MLAs meet KRMB today over Hyderabad's Nagarjuna Sagar water
twist: They will also object to Andhra Pradesh's tunnel works under the Palnadu Water Grid project.
